youtube._comment: Auto-discovers new uploads on its own via the channel's public RSS feed. Either field works: set channelId to the UC... ID (Channel > About > Share channel > Copy channel ID), or just set handle and the script resolves the ID itself.

instagram._comment: Auto-discovers recent posts/reels on its own — just set handle to the account's @username (no @). View counts aren't available (Instagram hides that from logged-out visitors), but likes/comments/dates are. videoUrls below is optional, for adding specific posts the auto-discovery might miss.

tiktok._comment: TikTok blocks even a real browser from loading a profile's video list while logged out, so unlike the other two this can't auto-discover — add each new video's URL here after posting it.
